title: Baba Mera Veer Maareya Zaaliman Bekhata
body:
Baba Mera Veer Maareya Zalima Bekhata
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Din Ch Haye Kayi Vaari, Main Veer Nu Marda Vekheya
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba Shabbir Utay Maut Bankay Aaya
Sab Ton Okha Vela
Jadon Barchi Khich Diyan Akbar
Da Jigar Vi Bahar Agaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaandeyan Khaimeyaan Chon Mar Gaya Veer Mera
Jadon Takeya Dhiyan
Eho Vain Akhri Keeta
Kubra Tay Sakina Alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye Bara Roya Si Jadon Poocheya Farwa
Ne Mere Veer Kolon
Das Veer Meray Qasim Da
Kya Har Ik Tukra Lab Gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Nannay Asghar Nu Jadon Teer Wajiya Baba
Maut Da Manzar Si Mera Veer Othay Mar Jaunda
Jenda Asghar Haskay Vekh Da
<<DIVIDER>>
Kithay Abbas Gaya Enna Daseya Bibi
Na Hi Haider Poocheya
Saqlain Mola Jaan Gaye
Jadon Vekhi Zainab Beyrida
